question: Should this release-tooling change land before its terminal immutable historical replay, with the replay performed immediately afterward from the exact trusted-main tooling SHA and required before publication?
rationale: The authoritative workflow intentionally accepts only landed trusted-main tooling, so code review cannot resolve whether the project accepts a merge-first, prove-before-publish sequence for this release boundary.

options.title: Land, replay, then publish
options.body: Approve the trusted-main sequence, merge the code, run the immutable historical ledger on the exact landed SHA, and prohibit regular publication until it passes.

options.title: Require a current-head rehearsal
options.body: Keep the PR draft until a non-authoritative current-head rehearsal demonstrates the reconciliation and every consumer-validation path before landing.

options.title: Pause the ledger rollout
options.body: Leave the existing release flow unchanged until the operational handoff and recovery procedure are redesigned.

recommendation.title: Land, replay, then publish
recommendation.body: Approve the trusted-main sequence, merge the code, run the immutable historical ledger on the exact landed SHA, and prohibit regular publication until it passes.
